name: sqlite-readonly-mcp
description: A read-only SQLite MCP server for remote Linux deployment that provides secure database querying via SELECT statements and table listing. It uses Bearer Token authentication and returns JSON results through Streamable HTTP, designed to run behind Nginx with HTTPS.

rawRecord.description: A read-only SQLite MCP server for remote Linux deployment that provides secure database querying via SELECT statements and table listing. It uses Bearer Token authentication and returns JSON results through Streamable HTTP, designed to run behind Nginx with HTTPS.

HOST.description: Host to bind the server to

PORT.description: Port to bind the server to

BEARER_TOKEN.description: Static Bearer token (can also use READONLY_TOKEN)

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed Host headers; should include Nginx external domain

SQLITE_MAX_ROWS.description: Maximum number of rows per query
